cadence.daily: hydrate active exact contract after session
cadence.roll: hydrate outgoing and incoming exact contracts with overlap
cadence.pre_campaign: run archive audit and attach JSON receipt

integrity_gates: first and last requested-session tick are attested
gaps and partial sessions are reported rather than filled
continuous contracts are never substituted for exact-roll evidence
order_flow_boundary: Last ticks are insufficient for historical bid/ask delta, imbalance, absorption, DOM, or queue claims.
Bid, Ask, and Last availability must be audited separately.
Replay/L1/L2 recording begins prospectively and cannot reconstruct unrecorded history.
